unit.description: the unit id from the batch file

text.description: what is wrong and what changes with the core count or draw order

evidence.description: the path from the R entry point to the defect, with file:line steps

test_file_slug.description: kebab-case words describing the behaviour; never a TODO number

test_code.description: the body of the test_that block, without the test_that line or closing brace

failure_contains.description: text that must appear in the failure message, or an empty string
